971class Device: 

972 """Represent a GPU and act as an entry point for cuda.core features. 

973  

974 This is a singleton object that helps ensure interoperability 

975 across multiple libraries imported in the process to both see 

976 and use the same GPU device. 

977  

978 While acting as the entry point, many other CUDA resources can be 

979 allocated such as streams and buffers. Any :obj:`~_context.Context` dependent 

980 resource created through this device, will continue to refer to 

981 this device's context. 

982  

983 Newly returned :obj:`~_device.Device` objects are thread-local singletons 

984 for a specified device. 

985  

986 Note 

987 ---- 

988 Will not initialize the GPU. 

989  

990 Parameters 

991 ---------- 

992 device_id : int, optional 

993 Device ordinal to return a :obj:`~_device.Device` object for. 

994 Default value of `None` return the currently used device. 

995  

996 """

1001 "_properties", 

1002 "_resources", 

1003 "_uuid", 

1004 "_context", 

1005 "__weakref__", 

1006 )

1073 def can_access_peer(self, peer: Device | int) -> bool: 

1074 """Check if this device can access memory from the specified peer device. 

1075  

1076 Queries whether peer-to-peer memory access is supported between this 

1077 device and the specified peer device. 

1078  

1079 Parameters 

1080 ---------- 

1081 peer : Device | int 

1082 The peer device to check accessibility to. Can be a :obj:`~_device.Device` object or device ID. 

1083 """ 

1084 peer = Device(peer) 

1085 cdef int d1 = <int> self.device_id 

1086 cdef int d2 = <int> peer.device_id 

1087 if d1 == d2: 

1088 return True 

1089 cdef int value = 0 

1090 with nogil: 

1091 HANDLE_RETURN(cydriver.cuDeviceCanAccessPeer(&value, d1, d2)) 

1092 return bool(value)

1247 def set_current(self, Context ctx: Context | None = None) -> Context | None: 

1248 """Set device to be used for GPU executions. 

1249  

1250 Initializes CUDA and sets the calling thread to a valid CUDA 

1251 context. By default the primary context is used, but optional `ctx` 

1252 parameter can be used to explicitly supply a :obj:`~_context.Context` object. 

1253  

1254 Providing a `ctx` causes the previous set context to be popped and returned. 

1255  

1256 If `ctx` was created on a different device than this receiver, the call 

1257 is delegated to that device's own :meth:`set_current`. This keeps the 

1258 owning device's bookkeeping consistent and lets a context this method 

1259 handed out for a foreign device be pushed back through any ``Device`` 

1260 object, matching the CUDA context stack's own thread-wide semantics. 

1261  

1262 Parameters 

1263 ---------- 

1264 ctx : :obj:`~_context.Context`, optional 

1265 Optional context to push onto this device's current thread stack. 

1266  

1267 Returns 

1268 ------- 

1269 :obj:`~_context.Context`, optional 

1270 The previous context, or ``None`` if no context was current. When 

1271 returned, its ``device_id`` identifies the device that was 

1272 previously current. 

1273  

1274 Examples 

1275 -------- 

1276 Acts as an entry point of this object. Users always start a code by 

1277 calling this method, e.g. 

1278  

1279 >>> from cuda.core import Device 

1280 >>> dev0 = Device(0) 

1281 >>> dev0.set_current() 

1282 >>> # ... do work on device 0 ... 

1283
